gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-kodchasan: Happy Monkey draws every stroke like a ruler-straight line, with wide gaps in the e, and Kodchasan lets its terminals hang open beside it. Loud on top, relaxed below, and the two never fight.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-koho: Happy Monkey holds its line weight steady like a stylus pressed at fixed pressure, while KoHo's body stays low-contrast and sans-serif. Paragraphs of it go down smoothly.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-kosugi: Bold and a bit cheeky, Happy Monkey stands over Kosugi, whose open-jawed c looks like a pair of pliers bent from wire. A long passage in it would read crisp and steady.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-kosugi-maru: Kosugi Maru glows like neon tubing, every stroke end set far apart. Its single line thickness is the pair's strongest link, since Happy Monkey draws with that same ruler-straight stroke up top.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-kumbh-sans: Kumbh Sans reads crisp, its terminals cut well short of the bowl with a fixed-pen feel. Happy Monkey is best at loud, wide-gapped display shapes; Kumbh Sans is best at holding text quietly together.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-lato: Lato brings wide s curves that barely curl in. Its size is the one to adjust, nudging the plain sans larger so it stands comfortably beside Happy Monkey's true monoline drawing.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-libre-franklin: Happy Monkey bends its s curves like wire, never thinning at the spine. Libre Franklin is the opposite in job: Happy Monkey grabs attention up top, while the sans body, with its splayed c terminal, carries the actual reading.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-livvic: Livvic keeps its curves free of stress and gives the c a generous opening, so it feels approachable. Happy Monkey's ruler-straight strokes then add the loud, bold voice above it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-lunasima: Playful and bold, Happy Monkey cuts stems and curves from one gauge of tubing. That is its best trick, while Lunasima, a sans with c tips that never creep toward touching, does best at staying out of the way.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-lxgw-marker-gothi: LXGW Marker Gothic opens its c wide, like a bracelet pulled apart. Happy Monkey's round letters, with rims matching the stems, join it in the pair's strongest quality: a gentle, smooth weight gradient below a firm heading.
